en.name: Fermented bean curd
en.summary: Fermented bean curd is tofu cubed and aged in brine, wine or a red rice mash, sold in small jars. No agency publishes a shelf life for it, and salt and alcohol content vary enormously between brands, so this record deliberately carries no number: follow the printed date, refrigerate after opening, and keep the cubes under their liquid.
en.pantry: Unopened jars keep to the printed date in a cool dark cupboard, away from the hob and out of the sun. There is no published figure to give here, which is why the date on the jar is the rule. Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety has found fermented bean curd contaminated with Bacillus cereus, and advises buying only from reputable suppliers, checking the date, and finishing it within the stated period. A jar with a domed lid, a broken seal or a leaking side should not be kept.
en.fridge: Refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once the jar is opened. Always lift cubes out with a clean dry spoon or chopsticks, and keep them fully covered by their brine or wine — the salt and the alcohol are what hold spoilage off, and a wet or food-soiled utensil seeds the jar. No agency gives a figure for how long an opened jar lasts, so use the maker's instruction and your own judgement. Discard the jar if the brine turns cloudy, gassy or smells of ammonia.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for fermented bean curd and freezing it is not the answer. The salt keeps it from freezing solid, and the cubes, which are soft and fragile to begin with, break down into mush in the brine. If a jar is lasting longer than you are comfortable with, buy the smaller size next time; this is a condiment used a cube or two at a time.
spoilage: Brine gone cloudy, ropy or visibly gassy
An ammonia or rotten smell rather than a salty, winey, cheese-like one
A bulging lid or fizzing when the jar is opened
Mould on cubes that have been sitting above the liquid
tips: Buy from a reputable supplier and check the printed date before you buy.
Use clean dry chopsticks and press the remaining cubes back under the liquid.
Never top the jar up with water; it dilutes the salt and alcohol doing the preserving.
Buy small jars — a cube or two goes a long way in a stir-fry or a marinade.

faq.q: How long does fermented bean curd last once opened?
faq.a: No agency publishes a figure, and salt and alcohol levels vary widely between brands. Refrigerate it, follow the maker's instruction, and keep the cubes under their liquid.

faq.q: Does fermented bean curd need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Unopened, no — a cool dark cupboard to the printed date. After opening, yes, at 4 °C or below.
Hong Kong CFS has found it contaminated with Bacillus cereus. Buy from reputable suppliers, check the date, and finish it within the stated period.

faq.q: Can you freeze fermented bean curd?
faq.a: There is no timeline and it is not worth doing. The salt stops it freezing solid and the cubes break down into mush.

zh.name: 豆腐乳
zh.summary: 豆腐乳是把豆腐切塊、在鹽水、酒或紅麴醬中發酵熟成，裝成小罐販售。沒有任何機構公布它的保存期限，而各品牌的鹽度和酒精含量差異極大，所以本篇刻意不給數字：請依照標示日期、開封後冷藏，並讓腐乳塊一直泡在湯汁裡。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐子放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃、遠離爐火與日曬，到標示日期為止。這裡沒有已發表的數字可以給，所以罐上的日期就是規則。香港食物安全中心曾驗出豆腐乳受仙人掌桿菌（Bacillus cereus）污染，建議向信譽良好的商家購買、確認日期，並在標示期限內吃完。蓋子鼓起、封口破損或側面滲漏的罐子就不要留。
zh.fridge: 開罐後請放 4 °C 以下冷藏。每次都用乾淨乾燥的湯匙或筷子夾取，並讓腐乳塊完全泡在鹽水或酒汁裡——真正在擋腐敗的就是鹽和酒精，而沾水或沾到菜的餐具等於幫罐子接種細菌。沒有機構給出開封後可以放多久，所以請依廠商指示並自行判斷。如果湯汁變濁、產氣或聞到氨味，整罐就要丟掉。
zh.freezer: 豆腐乳沒有冷凍期限，冷凍也不是答案。鹽分讓它凍不硬，而本來就軟嫩脆弱的腐乳塊會在湯汁裡散成糊。如果一罐放到讓你不安心，下次改買小罐；這是一次只用一兩塊的調味料。
spoilage: 湯汁變濁、出現絲狀物，或明顯產氣
聞起來是氨味或腐敗味，而不是鹹香帶酒味、類似乳酪的氣味
蓋子鼓起，或開罐時冒氣
露出液面的腐乳塊長霉
tips: 向信譽良好的商家購買，買之前先看標示日期。
用乾淨乾燥的筷子，取完把剩下的壓回液面以下。
絕對不要加水補液位；那會稀釋正在保存它的鹽和酒精。
買小罐——炒菜或做醃料時，一兩塊就很夠味。

faq.q: 豆腐乳開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 沒有機構公布數字，而且各品牌鹽度與酒精差異很大。請冷藏、依廠商指示，並讓腐乳塊保持泡在湯汁裡。
未開封不用，陰涼避光的櫥櫃放到標示日期即可。開封後要，放 4 °C 以下。
香港食安中心曾驗出受仙人掌桿菌污染。請向信譽良好的商家購買、確認日期，並在標示期限內吃完。
沒有對應期限，也不值得。鹽分讓它凍不硬，腐乳塊還會散成糊。
